name: @node-redis/client
description: The source code and documentation for this package are in the main [node-redis](https://github.com/redis/node-redis) repo.

readme.summary: Excellent clarity and examples with comprehensive usage patterns, but lacks troubleshooting guidance and the README appears truncated.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section for common errors (connection failures, timeout issues, authentication problems) and the README content appears incomplete (cuts off mid-example in the Scan Iterator section)

common_complaints: Type system inconsistencies and bugs (hGet return type)
Missing methods in certain client creation modes (sSubscribe with Sentinel)
Incomplete API surface in multi() context (commandOptions, sendCommand)
sentiment.summary: Community shows moderate health with active issue tracking and maintainer engagement, but recurring bugs in type definitions, connection handling, and API consistency across different client modes indicate technical debt that frustrates users seeking advanced features.

concerns: No commits in past 6 months despite last commit being today (2026-02-11)
294 open issues with no closed issues in past 6 months indicates unresponsive maintenance
Zero active contributors in past 6 months
No merged PRs in past 6 months suggests pull requests are not being reviewed
Unknown last release date indicates possible version stagnation
Large backlog of open issues with no resolution activity
maintenance.summary: The package appears abandoned with a massive unresolved issue backlog, zero recent contributions, and no maintenance activity despite a recent commit timestamp that may be misleading.
